meta.title: VIP Workflows — pull request preview
meta.description: Installs the VIP Workflows build from a pull request, seeds demo content and role users, and lands on the Workflows dashboard.
meta.author: vip-workflows

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

foreach ( array( 'editor', 'author', 'contributor' ) as $login ) {
	if ( username_exists( $login ) ) {
		continue;
	}
	wp_insert_user(
		array(
			'user_login'   => $login,
			'user_pass'    => 'password',
			'user_email'   => $login . '@example.test',
			'display_name' => ucfirst( $login ) . ' User',
			'role'         => $login,
		)
	);
}

<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once '/tmp/vip-workflows-demo/shift-wxr-dates.php';

$wxr = file_get_contents( '/tmp/vip-workflows-demo/vip-workflows-content.xml' );
if ( false === $wxr ) {
	throw new RuntimeException( 'Demo content was not extracted' );
}
file_put_contents(
	'/tmp/vip-workflows-demo/vip-workflows-content.current.xml',
	vip_workflows_shift_wxr_dates( $wxr, current_datetime() )
);
